text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Brian—! Are you seriously gonna sleep 
through the Droite— the actual dance party 
itself?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have no interest in messing around. 
Leave me alone.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You promised to have a one-on-one 
dance-off with me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I made no such promise.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hah! I seeee what you're doing, you're 
trying to run away. That means you don't 
have the confidence to beat me in a 
dance-off!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: "Wah! Brian...!?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Y-You're way too pushy!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Don't provoke me like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, looks like Brian will be joining as 
well. This year's Ligne Droite is fully 
prepared and ready.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for all your hard work as well. 
I hope it hasn't interfered with your own 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
No, I merely fulfilled my duty. ...All 
that remains is choosing my opponent.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I've received several invitations from 
underclassmen, so I shall choose 
appropriately.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oops. Looks like I've gotten a late start.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
I thought you were the only match for me, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Are you sure you don't want Teio?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"She's blessed with wonderful friends, 
after all. And besides..."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"I choose my own opponent. Allow me to 
make a formal challenge."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Won't you spend a time of singing, 
dancing, and merriment with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Good grief... You really are something 
else.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: ...With pleasure.
